notes: *through* is placed on the object marker under rule 16: it is the only English word spent on the object relation of the accusative of place traversed, and rule 44's limit hands the word to a present marker rather than to the verb.
*nothing* fuses `לֹא` and `דָּבָר` under rule 30, discontinuous around the verb; the source head was taken on the negative as rule 35 heads *Nor*, with the lexical noun named as the competing head.
